group_results.reason: This group adds regression assertions to graphemetest, a separate executable. It introduces no library behavior for the fuzz entry to cover.

The changed sentinel preservation and removal behavior belongs to mapping with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC together. The old target uses those options in separate calls and has no equivalent valid-input route.

build.reason: The delegated recipe enables testing, builds the CMake fuzzer target and copies that target to the requested output path; the changed test remains a separate target.

input.reason: A finite NUL-terminated ASCII and control-byte input fits the entry’s guards and reaches its mapping calls.

lifecycle.reason: Mapping initializes its result pointer, frees its buffer on error and returns allocated output on success. The entry frees each result and frees its separate UTF-32 copy.

control_flow.reason: The entry reaches direct normalization and mapping. Mapping delegates through decomposition and reencoding to normalization; the selected flags determine which changed branch can execute.
